parameters.content:
## Every email in the system starts here
No other workflow is allowed to send email directly. They all
call this one. That is deliberate: it means the consent check
below cannot be forgotten by whoever builds the next workflow,
because they never touch the mail server themselves.

nodes.name: 1. Every email in the system starts here

parameters.content:
## The consent gate
Read this person's most recent consent record for this channel.
Opted in: the mail goes. Anything else — opted out, bounced,
never asked — it does not, and we write down why. There is no
setting to skip this and no way around it.

## Send, and keep the receipt
Fill in the template and hand it to the mail server. Whether it
was sent or refused, a message log record is written either way,
so a refusal is evidence rather than silence. That log is what
we would show if someone asked whether we emailed a contact.

meta.description: Sub-workflow. Input: { personId, templateKey, mergeData }. Checks consent, renders the template, sends by SMTP, logs a messageLog. No other workflow may call SMTP directly.
